conventions.convention: Use an adapted Newtonian Cartesian inertial chart, SI units, and signed velocity along the selected positive spatial axis.
The calorically perfect relation has positive constants c_v and R, γ=1+R/c_v, and the energy reference e=c_v T.
Admissibility means ρ>0 and E−m²/(2ρ)>0; pressure is (γ−1)(E−m²/(2ρ)).

Adopt Countable Choice, complete Euclidean Lebesgue measures, almost-everywhere section integrals, and local integrability up to initial time. Initial data are distributional data, without an asserted strong trace.
The weak physical entropy inequality is separately adopted, with nonnegative tests and integrated sign ≤0; numerical entropy stability is not inferred.
Use periodic indexing modulo N≥2, Δx>0, Δt≥0, λ=Δt/Δx, and one shared flux at each face.
Each symmetric HLL face speed satisfies a≥max(|u_L|+c_L,|u_R|+c_R) and 2λa≤1, including equality. These supplied speeds are not certified enclosures of exact nonlinear waves.
Specific entropy is reconstructed using the natural logarithm of a positive dimensionless argument; thermodynamic pressure and fixed-entropy sound speed then agree with their numerical formulas.

load_bearing.statement: Adopt e(v,s)=c_v T_*(v_*/v)^(γ−1) exp((s−s_*)/c_v), with c_v,R,v_*,T_*>0 and γ=1+R/c_v, the inviscid one-dimensional conservative weak balances, and a separate physical entropy inequality. Numerical pressure agrees with thermodynamic pressure. No existence, uniqueness, or empirical validity is asserted.

For a periodic uniform mesh with N≥2, Δx>0, Δt≥0, ideal-gas states U_i∈G_γ, and symmetric HLL face speeds satisfying a≥max(|u_i|+c_i,|u_{i+1}|+c_{i+1}) and 2λa≤1, the stated shared-face update yields U_i⁺∈G_γ for every cell. Updated density and thermodynamic pressure are strictly positive. No exact-wave enclosure, fully discrete entropy inequality, convergence, or measurement agreement is asserted.

concerns.concern: Coordinate ordering is inconsistent. Fields and tests are declared on Ω×(0,T_f) and Ω×[0,T_f), respectively, but are evaluated as ρ(t,x), v(t,x), and φ(0,x). The conservative weak-form supplier explicitly uses spatial-first coordinates (x,t). For example, with Ω=(2,3) and T_f=1, φ(0,x) is outside the declared test domain. The intended initial value is clear, but the domain and evaluation conventions should agree throughout.

alerts.finding: The Postulate declares test functions on Ω×[0,T_f) but writes initial evaluations φ(0,x), ψ(0,x), η(0,x), and ζ(0,x). Its cited conservative weak-form definition explicitly uses spatial-first coordinates and φ(x,0). Thus the declared domain and evaluation order disagree; the intended weak identities remain recoverable.

The Statement says “Here n≥1” after an update indexed by j on an unspecified finite periodic array. No n was introduced or used in that formula. This dangling parameter does not affect the algebraic model balances or cancellation proof.

The Definition contains the malformed sentence “Under countable choice, Assuming countable choice, Lebesgue outer measure is an outer measure that restricts to elementary volume makes … an outer measure”. A later sentence also inserts a full theorem title into its grammar. The intended Countable Choice qualification and mathematical definitions are recoverable, but the prose needs correction.
